edits.old: The attempt limit of 5 and the exception-queue rule are service configuration of rwb-comms, not chart values (GAP-1071; ASM-2019).
edits.new: The attempt limit of 5 and the exception-queue rule are service configuration of rwb-comms, not chart values (GAP-1071; ASM-2019). An attempt is counted once per outbox relay window (JOB-11) as this message capability's own send attempt; the ACE notification path's internal retries are excluded from the count, and the platform relay owner confirms the window semantics. The masking version label, the covered personal field IDs, the access-log granularity and the parameter defaults are settled at the wave-2 policy load with Compliance and the data steward, with Internal audit and at build (GAP-2321), and the authorise element is confirmed at contract review; no rule, criterion or test value depends on them until then.
